snippet.title: Duck Side of the Moon - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Waddle and fly as a duck in space, coming to PC and Nintendo Switch on May 7th, 2026!

Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.
